name: ROBINS-I
license_note: Domain names and prompts are paraphrases. The official wording is linked, not bundled.
notes: The overall judgement is derived as the worst domain, with no_information placed between moderate and serious. Signalling answers are supporting detail only.

domains.name: Confounding
domains.short_prompt: Whether confounding was present and whether the analysis controlled for the important confounders.

signalling.prompt: Is there potential for confounding of the effect of intervention in this study?
Did the authors control for the important confounding domains?
Were the confounders measured validly and reliably?

domains.name: Selection of participants
domains.short_prompt: Whether selection into the study was related to intervention and outcome.

signalling.prompt: Was selection based on characteristics observed after the start of intervention?
Was selection related to both intervention and outcome?

domains.name: Classification of interventions
domains.short_prompt: Whether intervention status was defined and ascertained well enough to avoid misclassification.

signalling.prompt: Was intervention status based on records or recall likely to reflect the intervention?
Could classification have been affected by knowledge of outcome or risk factors?

domains.name: Deviations from intended interventions
domains.short_prompt: Whether deviations from the intended intervention were balanced or handled by an appropriate analysis.

signalling.prompt: Were there deviations beyond what would be expected in usual practice?
Were deviations balanced between groups, or was an appropriate analysis used?
Was an appropriate analysis used to estimate the effect of starting and adhering to the intervention?

domains.name: Missing data
domains.short_prompt: Whether missing outcome, confounder, or intervention data could bias the result.

signalling.prompt: Were outcome data available for all or nearly all participants?
Were participants excluded because of missing data?
Could missingness depend on the true value of the outcome?

domains.name: Measurement of outcomes
domains.short_prompt: Whether outcome measurement could have been influenced by intervention knowledge and was comparable across groups.

signalling.prompt: Could the outcome measure have been influenced by knowledge of the intervention received?
Were outcome assessors aware of the intervention received?
Were methods of outcome assessment comparable across groups?

domains.name: Selection of the reported result
domains.short_prompt: Whether the reported effect estimate could have been selected from multiple analyses.

signalling.prompt: Is the reported estimate likely to be selected from multiple measurements, analyses, subgroups, or time points?
Were the reported results consistent with a pre-specified analysis plan?
